jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Markdom International has a proven history of producing world-class custom injection-molded products for the automotive and consumer goods industries. We have the capability to produce an extensive variety of products with our state-of-the-art in-house injection mold design and build capabilities, coupled with the latest injection molding process technologies.

Markdom is looking for a dynamic individual to join our team as a Director of Finance

Key Responsibilities:
Lead and mentor a team of eight accounting professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Consolidate financial statements from eight separate manufacturing plants into corporate-level reporting.
Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness including visiting plants monthly to coordinate with the finance team to meet such targets.
Monitor cash flow, working capital, and liquidity across all entities.
Partner with plant controllers to ensure alignment on accounting policies and procedures.
Develop and understand an appreciation of the day-to-day activities for each plant, including coordinating with vendors and suppliers as needed. Coordinate with individual General Managers for understanding their financial needs.
Analyze variances and provide actionable recommendations to improve financial performance.
Develop and maintain robust internal controls and compliance with GAAP (ASPE) standards.
Prepare and present consolidated financial reports to senior leadership and stakeholders.
Manage annual audits and coordinate with external auditors.
Implement and optimize ERP systems and financial reporting tools.
Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy in financial operations.
Support budgeting and forecasting processes, providing consolidated insights for strategic planning.
Ensure compliance with tax regulations and oversee corporate tax filings.
Lead special projects such as system upgrades, mergers/acquisitions integration, and cost optimization initiatives.
Responsibility for treasury function.
Assessment of corporate financing alternatives.
Travel once a month on average with more frequent travel where issues arise at plants (mostly travel to Michigan, Ohio, Tennessee)

Qualifications

Strong foundation in Finance with demonstrated experience in corporate or manufacturing environments.
Proficiency in Financial Planning and budgeting, including forecasting and long-range financial modeling.
Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Financial Statements and financial reporting packages.
Advanced Analytical Skills, including variance analysis, cost analysis, and data interpretation for decision support.
Experience with Financial Reporting to senior leadership and external stakeholders, including banks and auditors.
Professional accounting designation (CPA or equivalent) and a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field.
Knowledge of ERP systems and advanced Excel skills; familiarity with manufacturing cost accounting is an asset.
Proven leadership abilities, including managing finance teams, setting priorities, and driving process improvements.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience in automotive or industrial manufacturing, particularly injection moulding or Tier 1 supplier environments, is an advantage.

Markdom is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, is committed to diversity and inclusivity in employment, and welcomes applications from qualified individuals of diverse backgrounds. Markdom is also committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Data, AI, & Cloud
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are, all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location

This role will be based out of one of our major US or Canada
office locations: Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

The Opportunity

This business unit specializes in data-driven solutions and strategic AI implementation. We help our clients unlock the full potential of their data and transform their business through innovative, AI-powered strategies.

Our Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud, will lead our Data & AI advisory, AI solutions, Data platforms, and cloud transformation capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and success of the practice. You will provide strategic guidance, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver outstanding client value across our global footprint. The Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud will have P&L responsibility and will play a critical role in shaping our company's overall vision, strategy, and growth.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a talented and results-oriented leader to make a significant impact in shaping our company's future and driving data-driven solutions in the evolving digital landscape. If you are passionate about data, AI, and strategic consulting, we invite you to apply and join our high-performing team.

To learn more about our AI practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-ai

To learn more about our Cloud practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-technology-modernization/cloud-services

Responsibilities

Strategy and Leadership:

Collaborate with the executive leadership team to define the company's Data, AI & Cloud vision, strategy, and goals
Drive growth by identifying emerging trends, market opportunities, and industry best practices
Lead the planning, development, and execution of the Data, AI & Cloud strategic roadmap

P&L Responsibility

Assume overall accountability for the financial performance of the Data, AI & Cloud consulting practice
Partner with Practice Leaders and Business Development to continue to grow managed accounts
In partnership with Business Development, develop and implement effective revenue generation strategies to meet or exceed annual revenue targets
Monitor financial performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as necessary

Team Leadership And Management

Build and lead high-performing teams, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Strategists, and AI Engineers
Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the Data, AI & Cloud teams globally and more broadly through the Practice Advisor team

Client Engagement And Delivery

Partner with clients to identify their business challenges and design tailored Data, AI & Cloud solutions
Oversee the delivery of high-quality data-driven insights, models, and strategic recommendations
Provide thought leadership and build trusted advisor relationships with key client stakeholders

Competencies

Experience

10+ years of relevant leadership and team management experience within a top-tier management consultancy (Partner-level) or global and publicly traded enterprise (VP, SVP, or C-level) with a focus on AI, Data Engineering, Data Science, or Related Fields
Leads a line of business for a mid-size to large consultancy (i.e., office, industry, etc.)
Leadership experience in technology consulting, project management, and executive partnerships
Clear and tested experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing P&L responsibilities

Industry Knowledge

In-depth knowledge of Data Engineering, Data Science, and AI technologies and tools
Familiarity with emerging trends, best practices, and advancements in Data, AI & Cloud applications
Track record of being a dynamic decision-maker and having adaptability in a quickly changing environment
Deep knowledge of customer experience strategies and digital transformation

Leadership Competencies

Exceptional leadership and people management skills, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams
Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with strong business acumen
Proven ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with clients and key stakeholders

Communication And Collaboration

Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex ideas effectively to C-level and Executive audiences
Strong collaborator with the ability to work seamlessly across diverse teams and cultures
Proficiency in English is required; additional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Compensation Range: $236K - $310K

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Client Group Finance
jobs.description:
Job Description

Mobility

This role requires occasional travel within Alberta.

What is the opportunity?

As Director, Corporate Client Group Finance (CCGF), you are part of the mid-market Corporate Banking team and play a key role in the realization of Corporate Client Group (CCG) objectives through the structuring, delivery and management of the bank debt of a targeted customer base. We target loan origination in the Canadian mid-market, including large Canadian subsidiaries of foreign multinationals, private and small cap public Canadian companies, and are responsible for meeting annually established targets for loan derived revenues and returns by providing advice to our partners on optimizing the use of lending in connection with broader RBC relationship goals.

What will you do?

Collaborate with CCG relationship managers to structure, deliver, close, and monitor syndicated and bi-lateral loan transactions
Support CCG relationship managers in the preparation and presentation of marketing pitches to existing and potential clients
Manage all aspects of the credit approval process including credit submissions, developing strong working relationships with Group Risk Management.
Actively engage and coordinate with key RBC partners including Group Risk Management, Private Banking, RBC Investments, Capital Markets, Global Transaction Banking, Leasing, Personal Banking, and others
Provide research, analysis, and data (market, industry, client, and competitor) to support CCG advice on the optimal amount of bank debt required to meet strategic objectives with each client relationship.
Take part in the national team of CCG Finance underwriters committed to the delivery of quality credit products to RBC clients and targets.
Provide analysis and support to Senior Director CCG Finance and CCG Finance colleagues for advice on risk and return associated with loan transactions contemplated as part of client strategies

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Accounting, or Finance
5+ years’ of related work experience in commercial or corporate lending at a major financial institution
Quantitative, financial modeling, and analytical skills with an ability to analyze company financial statements.
Strong knowledge of credit, credit metrics, and credit structuring.
Experience with review and negotiation of legal documentation.
Professional oral and written communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
Ability to perform well under pressure, meet time sensitive deadlines, prioritize work and multi-task responsibilities while working on multiple projects
Strong collaboration and client relationship skills
Advanced skills with Excel, Word, PowerPoint and the ability to source data/research

Nice-to-have

CFA, CPA or other relevant professional designation – ongoing or completed

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Opportunities to do challenging work

Job Skills

Commercial Credit Underwriting, Corporate Banking, Corporate Lending, Credit Structuring, Financial Analysis, Quantitative Analysis
